Description
This bullion 10 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar remains the most popular and best-selling investment in the world. This bullion product is a wise investment and an interesting collectible product, and a lovely gift to offer. 10 gram Pamp Suisse gold bar is a part of the most popular series of the PAMP, i.e., the Lady Fortuna Series. PAMP (Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux) is the world’s leading bullion brand. One of the most reliable refiners and producers of precious metals.
The 10 Gram PAMP Suisse gold bar contains 10g (0.3215 oz) of .9999 pure gold and depicts the popular Lady Fortuna Image. Each bar’s authenticity can be confirmed using the latest technology by PAMP Suisse
Veriscan ®
worldwide. Because of their globally recognized design, these gold bars are liquidated and easy to trade.
Design of
10 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
The obverse of this 10 gram Pamp Suisse gold bar depicts the blindfolded lady Fortuna and sharing her rich cornucopia with others – the symbol of the unpredictability of life and luck. Similarly, the reverse side of the Pamp Suisse 10 gram gold bar features the distinctive PAMP logo comprised of “PAMP” in four small circles, followed by the term “Sussie” underneath it. Another inscription on the back of the gold bars is purity, weight, assayers mark, weight, and a unique serial number.
Main Highlights of 10 Gram PAMP Suisse Gold Bar – Lady Fortuna
Contains 10 gram (0.3215 oz) of .9999 pure gold.
Made by the world-renowned precious metal refiner PAMP Suisse.
To ensure its legality, each gold bar is supplied with an assay card.
The product is manufactured using Veriscan Technology that utilizes the metal’s microscopic surface to determine the product.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs and guaranteed by PAMP Suisse.
On the front, Lady Fortuna,  the Roman goddess of luck, and fortune is depicted.
On the reverse side is the PAMP Suisse logo, along with the purity, weight, and serial number.
The unique serial code is assigned to each bar.
